facts.statement: Malefica is a genus of hadrosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Malefica (meaning "witch" or "sorceress") is a genus of hadrosaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous (Campanian) Aguja Formation of Texas, United States.

facts.statement: The only known species in the genus Malefica is Malefica deckerti.
facts.quote: The type and only species is Malefica deckerti.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, a partial left maxilla, was recovered from Bruja Canyon in Big Bend National Park.
facts.quote: The holotype of Malefica deckerti, TxVP 41917-1, is a partial left maxilla recovered from Bruja Canyon in Big Bend National Park.

facts.statement: In 2002, the specimen was initially assigned to the genus Kritosaurus as cf. K. navajovius.
facts.quote: In 2002, it was assigned to the genus Kritosaurus, as cf. K. navajovius.

facts.statement: Twenty years after its initial assignment, the fragmentary specimen was described as a new taxon due to useful diagnostic traits.
facts.quote: Twenty years later, it was discovered to contain a number of useful diagnostic traits that allowed it to be described as a new taxon, despite being fragmentary.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis recovered Malefica as a basal member of Hadrosauridae, outside the clade Saurolophidae.
facts.quote: Prieto-Márquez & Wagner (2023) performed a phylogenetic analysis which recovered Malefica as a basal member of the Hadrosauridae, outside the clade Saurolophidae (=Euhadrosauria), which contains the major subfamilies Lambeosaurinae and Saurolophinae.

facts.statement: Malefica fossils are known from the Texan side of the Aguja Formation, which also outcrops in Mexico.
facts.quote: The Aguja Formation outcrops both in Texas and the neighboring Mexican states of Chihuahua and Coahuila. Malefica is known from the Texan side.

facts.statement: Malefica lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous, approximately 81 to 76 million years ago, in what is now North America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 81 a 76 millones de años, durante el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Norteamérica.

facts.statement: The time range for Malefica is recorded as Campanian, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Malefica is classified within the family Hadrosauridae.
The genus authority for Malefica is Prieto-Márquez & Wagner, 2022.
The species authority for Malefica deckerti is Prieto-Márquez & Wagner, 2022.
The parent group for the genus Malefica is Hadrosauridae.
The type species of the genus Malefica is Malefica deckerti.

rejected.statement: The generic name "Malefica" means "witch" or "sorceress" in Latin, referencing its discovery in Bruja Canyon.
rejected.quote: The generic name, "Malefica", means "witch" or "sorceress" in Latin, referring to its discovery in Bruja Canyon (bruja being Spanish for "witch").
